name: Software Engineering
intro: Developers and engineers who build, test and ship your product, from the front end to the infrastructure.

roleDetails.text: Builds features across the front end and back end, from the database to the screens your users see.
Builds the interfaces your users click through, in frameworks like React or Vue, fast and accessible.
Builds the APIs, services and databases that power your product, and keeps them secure and reliable.
Builds and ships your iOS and Android apps, from new features to app store releases.
Sets up the cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines and monitoring that keep your product online.
Tests new features, writes automated tests and catches bugs before your customers do.
Builds and maintains your website and store on platforms like Shopify, Webflow or WordPress.
Sets the technical direction, designs how the systems fit together and guides the engineering team.
